exec /usr/bin/python3 - <<'CHECK'
import json, os, signal, socket, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
os.makedirs('/run/containerd', exist_ok=True)
rows = []
for i in range(20):
    ident = 'trames-shim-' + str(i)
    work = Path('/work') / ident
    work.mkdir()
    (work/'config.json').write_text('{"annotations":{}}')
    os.mkfifo(work/'log')
    log = os.open(work/'log', os.O_RDWR | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/containerd-shim-runc-v2', '-namespace', 'moby', '-id', ident,
                             '-address', '/run/containerd/containerd.sock', 'start'],
                            cwd=work, input=b'', capture_output=True, timeout=20)
    row = dict(iteration=i, starter=result.returncode, stderr=result.stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
    try:
        assert result.returncode == 0, row
        address = result.stdout.decode().strip().removeprefix('unix://')
        def connect():
            with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as peer:
                peer.settimeout(2)
                peer.connect(address)
        connect()
        data = b''
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
        while b'io.containerd.ttrpc.v1.task' not in data:
            try: data += os.read(log, 65536)
            except BlockingIOError: pass
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'shim initialization did not complete: ' + data.decode(errors='replace')
            connect()
            time.sleep(.01)
        connect()
        children = []
        for proc in Path('/proc').iterdir():
            if not proc.name.isdecimal(): continue
            try:
                args = (proc/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
                if ident.encode() in args and b'start' not in args: children.append(int(proc.name))
            except (OSError, ValueError): pass
        assert len(children) == 1, ('live shim process', children)
        os.kill(children[0], signal.SIGTERM)
        pid, status = os.waitpid(children[0], 0)
        assert pid == children[0] and status in (0, signal.SIGTERM), ('shim exit', pid, status)
        row.update(initialized=True, status=status)
    finally:
        os.close(log)
        rows.append(row)
        Path('/work/shim-startup.log').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')
Path('/work/shim-startup.result').write_text('shim-startup: ok\n')
CHECK
